summary_en: This Phase 1/Phase 2 study tests tovorafenib with rituximab in classical hairy cell leukemia that has come back or did not respond to prior treatment. It also compares this combination with cladribine plus rituximab in patients who have not had treatment yet. Tovorafenib is taken by mouth and rituximab is given through a vein, with weekly dosing for up to 16 weeks in one arm and 28-day cycles for up to 4 cycles in another, while the cladribine arm uses 28-day cycles for up to 3 cycles. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is described as testing safety, side effects, and effectiveness, and is listed as Phase 1/Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/fase 2 evalúa tovorafenib con rituximab en leucemia de células pilosas clásica que volvió a aparecer o que no respondió a tratamientos previos. También compara esta combinación con cladribina más rituximab en pacientes que aún no han recibido tratamiento. El tovorafenib se toma por vía oral y el rituximab se administra por vena, con dosis semanales durante hasta 16 semanas en un brazo y ciclos de 28 días por hasta 4 ciclos en otro, mientras que el brazo de cladribina usa ciclos de 28 días por hasta 3 ciclos. La medida principal de resultado no se indica en el registro; el estudio se describe como una prueba de seguridad, efectos secundarios y efectividad, y figura como fase 1/fase 2.
who_for: Classical hairy cell leukemia with a confirmed BRAF V600E mutation.
Phase 1: prior purine nucleoside analog treatment, unless contraindicated; prior vemurafenib alone is allowed in the relapsed or refractory group.
Phase 2: no prior hairy cell leukemia treatment for the front-line group.
Meets stated criteria for needing treatment, such as low neutrophils, low platelets, or low hemoglobin.
not_for: BRAF V600E mutation negative or variant hairy cell leukemia.
Taking warfarin or direct oral anticoagulants.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or unwilling to use adequate contraception.
Prior allergic reaction to similar compounds or severe infusion reaction to rituximab.
